items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sometimes you heard that with Mel Garner, but more so with Fats.

ctx.x: What did you like about him?

His sense of rhythm, his happiness. When you heard him, you felt happiness and a sense of joy, you know? Sometimes you heard that with Mel Garner, but more so with Fats. You know, sometimes some of the comments he would make while he was playing—he just exuded happiness. He made you feel good listening, you know? That irresistible rhythm was just contagious. It was that two-handed rhythm.
